description: This file defines the JobCategoryService class responsible for managing job categories within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and normalizing job category data, and interacts with the JobCategoryDao data access object.

classes.name: JobCategoryService
classes.description: Service class managing job categories, providing methods for data retrieval, creation, deletion, and normalization within the HRM system.

methods.name: getJobCategoryDao
methods.description: Returns the current JobCategoryDao instance used by the service.

methods.name: setJobCategoryDao
methods.description: Sets the JobCategoryDao instance for the service.

methods.name: getJobCategoryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job categories with optional sorting, limiting, and counting.

methods.name: getJobCategoryById
methods.description: Fetches a specific job category by its identifier.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Saves a JobCategory entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteJobCategory
methods.description: Deletes multiple job categories based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getJobCategoryArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized job category data.
